newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota Power to supply Inland Steel mine.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota Power to supply Inland Steel mine.

text.p: Minnesota Power & Light Co on Tuesday said it signed an exclusive agreement to provide electricity to Inland Steel Industries Inc's Minorca Mine for the next 11 years. Terms were not disclosed.
The plant produces about 2.7 million tons of taconite iron pellets annually. The pellets are used to make steel.
The utility said the agreement was subject to approval by the Minnesota Public Utilities Commission.
Minnesota Power is the principal supplier of electricity to the Mesabi Iron Range, an area in Minnesota with a concentration of ore producers.
Its shares were up 1/8 at 28-1/2 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
